name: virgostars-desktop
description: Open-source-ready experimental VirgoStars desktop Angular workstation with synthetic Astrological Charts renderer

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run verify:ipc && npm run build:ui
scripts.start: npm run prepare:frontend && ng serve desktop --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4200
scripts.build:ui: npm run prepare:frontend && ng build desktop && npm run verify:bundle
scripts.tauri:dev: node scripts/verify-tauri-security-config.mjs && npm run prepare:icon && tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build: npm run build:ui && npm run prepare:icon && tauri build
scripts.verify:bundle: node scripts/verify-offline-bundle.mjs && npm run verify:privacy && node scripts/verify-tauri-security-config.mjs
scripts.tauri:build:places:windows: npm run places:fetch:windows && py -3 scripts/places/prepare_tauri_bundle.py && npm run verify:ipc && npm run verify:places-override && npm run build:ui && npm run prepare:icon && tauri build --config .local/places/tauri-places.conf.json
scripts.build:ui:private: npm run prepare:frontend:private && ng build desktop --configuration private-artwork && npm run verify:bundle:private
scripts.verify:bundle:private: node scripts/verify-offline-bundle.mjs --private && npm run verify:privacy && node scripts/verify-tauri-security-config.mjs
scripts.tauri:build:private: npm run build:ui:private && npm run prepare:icon && tauri build
scripts.tauri:build:places:private:windows: npm run places:fetch:windows && py -3 scripts/places/prepare_tauri_bundle.py && npm run verify:ipc && npm run verify:places-override && npm run build:ui:private && npm run prepare:icon && tauri build --config .local/places/tauri-places.conf.json
